_README: Sourced values cite their source. Values marked ASSUMPTION are team assumptions, disclosed in the write-up.
_discount_rate_source: USDOT BUILD Grants: Preparing a Benefit-Cost Analysis (Feb 2026): 'Use a 7% discount rate for all benefits and costs.' https://www.transportation.gov/sites/dot.gov/files/2026-02/BUILD%20Grants%20Preparing%20a%20Benefit-Cost%20Analysis%202-2-26.pdf
_value_of_time_source: USDOT BCA Guidance (Appendix A), personal auto travel, $21.80 per person-hour, as used in USDOT BUILD BCA guide (Feb 2026). Applied per vehicle (conservative; ignores 1.52 avg occupancy).
_property_uplift_source: ASSUMPTION: illustrative property value uplift near improved infrastructure
_reference_class_source: Road and bridge: Flyvbjerg (2005), World Bank Policy Research Working Paper 3781, Table 1 (roads N=167, bridges/tunnels N=33), citing Flyvbjerg, Holm & Buhl (2002). https://arxiv.org/pdf/1303.7400. Water: ASSUMPTION (no Flyvbjerg category).
_small_project_scale_source: No scaling applied: Flyvbjerg rates used as published.
